title: Uber rival inDrive eyes 2027 robotaxi tests in Central Asia with Pony.ai and Nvidia | TechCrunch
summary: Ride-hailing company inDrive , known for letting passengers and drivers negotiate fares, is working with Chinese autonomous driving firm Pony.ai and Nvidia to begin testing robotaxis in Kazakhstan in 2027.
